projects.title: TT B141 Cognitive Risk Estimation
bullets: Built a Python system estimating cognitive-decline risk from a digital Montreal Cognitive Assessment, focusing on explainable outputs clinicians could interpret.
Structured longitudinal follow-up data from the digital assessment, wanting the numbers behind the app to be trustworthy, not just functional.

projects.title: mHealth Android App
bullets: Developed a native Android app in Kotlin with Room and Coroutines for local-first emotional tracking, guided meditation, and cognitive-stimulation exercises.
Noticed the app's local tracking data could reveal usage patterns beyond feature testing, which shaped interest in the later data project.

projects.title: Individual Software Engineering Project
bullets: Delivered an individual software engineering project in Java with an HTML and CSS front end, including automated tests and Docker packaging.

leadership.title: Member
bullets: Started informally comparing app usage logs with self-reported mood entries, curious whether the numbers matched what users actually said.
